svg.title: Inter-Region Couplings: Cell-Link Region Exchange vs Surface RKKY
svg.desc: Two-panel comparison of FullMag inter-region couplings: (a) cell-to-cell harmonic, scaled-harmonic, explicit, and disabled exchange A_ab across adjacent ObjectRegion faces (executable on single-layer FDM), and (b) bilayer FM1/spacer/FM2 interfacial geometry with real oscillating RKKY coupling J_RKKY(t) proportional to cos(2 k_F t + phi_0)/t^2 showing FM (J_1 > 0) and AFM (J_1 < 0) thickness zones and bilinear/biquadratic surface energy (authored_only ProblemIR).
svg.text: Adjacent ObjectRegion faces · FDM single-layer executable
